cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_questionnaire_presentation_worker C CXX)
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable worker fixture" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui)
target_sources(cui PRIVATE "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/src/components/cui_questionnaire_presentation.c")
add_executable(test_questionnaire_presentation "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_questionnaire_presentation.c")
target_link_libraries(test_questionnaire_presentation PRIVATE cui)
target_compile_options(test_questionnaire_presentation PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -UNDEBUG)
add_test(NAME questionnaire_presentation COMMAND test_questionnaire_presentation)
add_library(questionnaire_presentation_header OBJECT "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_questionnaire_presentation_header.cpp")
target_link_libraries(questionnaire_presentation_header PRIVATE cui)
target_compile_features(questionnaire_presentation_header PRIVATE cxx_std_11)
target_compile_options(questionnaire_presentation_header PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
file(READ "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/QUESTIONNAIRE_PRESENTATION.md" guide)
string(REGEX MATCH "```c\n([^`]+)```" guide_code "${guide}")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/guide.c" "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
add_library(questionnaire_presentation_guide OBJECT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/guide.c")
target_link_libraries(questionnaire_presentation_guide PRIVATE cui)
target_compile_options(questionnaire_presentation_guide PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
